title: Uncovering stories of women
text: I was looking for options to tie in empowering stories of women to my women’s empowerment retreat, and found absolute gold. Laura is a powerhouse of information, and she delivers it with passion. Her PHD on women, and her recent book release honoring stories of women in Seville ( who until now were barely mentioned) add unique connections you won’t find with other tours. My group enjoyed this tour so much, and continued discussing the stories days after where we also learned more with Alba during our Alcazar tour. title: Amazing tours. Highly recommend
text: We did three tours with this company as we enjoyed our first tour so much. Alba is great to work with and I highly recommend her company. We did the women of Seville and Italica tour with her and she helped set up a cathedral and palace tour with her colleague Beatriz that was great as well.
author: cindymay

title: Terrific tour
text: Alba was extraordinary and one of the best tour guides I’ve ever had. She is knowledgeable, and excellent at weaving together historical events and ideas,  with stories of the people. Her knowledge is deep; she is a true student of Sevilla and its history and continues to research and work into her talk, the results of newer research. The fact that she focused on women made it all the more fascinating.  Highly recommend this tour.
author: Venture612630

title: Fabulous Tour
text: Alba Delgado was terrific! She’s knowledgeable, clear, friendly, and flexible.
author: carolinesyaya

title: History and the Women who made it!
text: This is a must do tour while in Seville!  Alba was ultra informative as she told us stories about many of the women that have made history in Seville. She is a great storyteller and always backed her story with the historical origin facts that engaged us for the entire two hour experience.
author: Debra_K

title: Extraordinary, Lively, Smart Alba, great work!
text: Alba was an extraordinary tour guide. The careful attention to human stories brought history alive. She was warm, smart, and welcomed questions. Great sense of humor. We selected the under told history of women- who worked to get them the vote. And we didn’t know Isabel was queen and Ferdinand was just her consort in her lifetime. Amazing and engaging information of Jewish women in medieval times that were doctors or business owners. Thank goodness for Alba’s driving interest. We can’t recommend her more highly for any tour.
author: Heather D

title: Highly recommend!
text: We went on the History of Women of Seville tour with Alba. It was amazing!  She is an excellent guide, very knowledgeable, professional, and passionate about history and culture. We learned a lot and will definitely do more tours with Alba in the future!
author: Sarasolen

title: Ask for Alba - she is terrific!
text: It was a delightful private tour with Alba, and we were both pleased with her personable nature and fun delivery of historical facts focusing on women. It was such a pleasant two hours of walking and listening and asking questions - all expertly handled by Alba. She is well educated, and brings her interesting research about high profile, but not famous women to the tour in an engaging and conversational way. author: TownsendTravels

title: A new angle to Seville
text: Loved this tour. Alba had so many interesting insights into the history and culture of Seville. Learnt so much during this tour.
author: TC_R

title: Great tour, really interesting, Alba is lovey.
text: We went with Alba through With Locals and it was fantastic! Highly recommend this tour. Alba was flexible with our timing and made it interesting for all of us. We learned a lot and enjoyed our tour very much. One of the highlights of our trip. Book with Alba!
